text.tspan: Every arrow is an event, never a poll. Services stay reactive and stateless —
Redis carries communication, the database carries truth.
The move was a change of deployment target, not a rewrite — because the services were
already reactive and stateless, poll-to-push was natural. The reactive seam was the enabler.
Workers PULL from size-stratified Redis queues;
a bespoke loop watches depth and moves pods.
The platform PUSHES each chunk to a worker that
scales from zero; native autoscale, no custom scaler.
